name: generic

isolation.why: Fill in if the project installs editable into a shared venv (see profiles/django.json).

regenerate.why: Command that rebuilds generated artifacts after a merge; regenerate, never hand-merge.

security_patterns: hardcoded secrets, API keys, or passwords
raw SQL with string interpolation (SQL injection)
XSS in HTML output (unescaped user input)
auto_reject_triggers: print() or console.log() left in production code
tests reference modules/APIs that don't exist in the diff

merge.why: squash | merge | rebase; whether --admin is sanctioned

artifacts: the bucket's matrix rows are struck through
RETRO.md has an entry for the bucket

test.why: A regression test proves nothing until it has been shown RED without the fix.
